t: A LoRa radio board with a 2.9 inch e-paper screen for Meshtastic.
steps: Buy the board from the Heltec store or a reseller. Pick the HF or LF version with the LoRa module and the band for your country.
Screw the LoRa antenna onto its connector before you power it up.
Plug the board into a computer with a USB-C cable.
Open the Meshtastic web flasher in a browser and flash the firmware. Hold the BOOT button while plugging in to retry a failed flash.
Install the Meshtastic app on your phone and pair over Bluetooth.
Set your region in the app to match local radio rules.
Send a test message to a friend with a second node.
To write your own code, install the Arduino IDE or CircuitPython and try a screen drawing example.
meta: Open Board. From $29.97. A few stores.
